info.name: Flow 11 – Warehouse & Shipping
info.description: Complete warehouse and shipping flow covering inbound shipment booking, inspector queue and inspection, inspection review (approve/reject/condition-mismatch), warehouse item storage, outbound shipment booking, GHN webhook tracking simulation, shipment cancellation, storage management, and error cases.

request.description: Reject the inspection. A Reason is required when Decision is 'reject'. This will mark the item as rejected from platform inspection.

item.name: 11. Review — Condition Mismatch (approve but condition differs)

request.description: Approve the inspection when the inspected condition differs from the declared condition. This results in a 'condition_confirmation_required' status, where the seller must confirm the updated condition before the auction can proceed.
Retrieve the inbound shipment after inspection review. Verify the status has changed to Inspected.
